exchange.title: DPP filings
exchange.intro: Receive prosecution files from a DPP office as sealed files, register them with the court's own number, and send the receipt back. Everything works with no internet.
exchange.identity_desc: Give the registry its identity once, as the DPP offices that file to it know it. It cannot be changed afterwards.
exchange.offices_desc: Invite an office with a file. It answers, you confirm its fingerprint by typing what it reads out, and only then can it file here.
exchange.open_file: Open a file from the office
exchange.none_offices: No office has been invited yet.
exchange.filings_desc: A filing is held here until a person reads it and registers it. Nothing enters the register by itself.
exchange.invite_saved: Invitation saved for {office}. Send it to them.
exchange.confirmed: {office} is confirmed. Send it the confirmation file.
exchange.registered_notice: Registered as {number}. Send the receipt back.
